description.en: Join us for free specialty coffee tastings from 10 AM to 2 PM at 18 River Street!

directions.promptModifier: Composition: dynamic diagonal layout with bold typography and engaging imagery of coffee cups and beans; focal point on 'Morrow Coffee' in hand-lettered script. Palette: earthy tones of rich brown, soft beige, and warm terracotta, creating a comforting vibe. Materials/texture: textured paper background resembling coffee sack fabric, mixed media elements like watercolor splashes and ink drips. Typography: expressive script for the shop name paired with a modern sans-serif for dates and location. Mood: warm, inviting, creative, perfect for social media sharing.

directions.promptModifier: Composition: clean and minimal grid layout, all elements centered with ample white space; striking visual of a coffee cup against a light backdrop. Palette: monochromatic scheme with shades of soft white and muted gray, emphasized with a single accent color — vibrant coffee brown. Materials/texture: smooth matte finish with a hint of gloss on the coffee cup image for depth. Typography: bold sans-serif for the shop name, simple thin font for the date and location, ensuring readability. Mood: elegant, modern, sophisticated, appealing to young professionals.

directions.promptModifier: Composition: playful collage of overlapping coffee-related visuals, incorporating textures and graphics that create a sense of movement; the name 'Morrow Coffee' prominently displayed at the top.
